step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts Samsung Health's high-scale backend handling 35,000 requests per second. Traffic enters via API Gateway, which connects to an internal Network Load Balancer (NLB) using VPC Link. The NLB forwards traffic to target groups across EKS clusters using port forwarding to NodePorts. On the observability side, CloudWatch collects infrastructure metrics and receives logs from Fluentd daemonsets on EKS, streaming them to Elasticsearch (OpenSearch). Application microservices also report performance traces directly to AWS X-Ray.
